in_marathi.name: Krishnaan
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Dark one, Black God
in_marathi.long_meaning: Krishnaan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Krishnaan is derived from Krishna, which means 'black' or 'dark'. In Hindu mythology, Lord Krishna is considered the eighth avatar of Vishnu, and is known for his divine play and mischievous antics. The name is often associated with love, compassion, and wisdom.
